verdict.rationale: Wrike's own pricing docs mention no-code automations and natural-language automation rule generation, so a rule-based automation feature exists. However, the evidence never shows how rules are defined, which events can trigger them, or what actions they can take. Missing for 10: documented event triggers and condition/action model, the scope of rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform
